caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular arrangement of nine smaller squares, each featuring a distinct fabric-like pattern and color. In the top row, the left square contains a diagonal half-and-half design with a cream background, yellow diagonal stripes, and red flowers with black leaves, while the right half features the same cream background without the floral pattern. The middle square in the top row displays vertical blue stripes separated by rows of small blue plus-signs on a cream background. The right square in the top row is divided diagonally into two triangles, one with a pinkish background and scattered white and red leaves, and the other a cream background. In the middle row, the left square has a repeating wavy horizontal line of small black shapes on a cream background. The center square features a plaid pattern in red, yellow, blue, and brown lines crossing over a cream background. The right square of the middle row has small clusters of red dots arranged in rows and columns on a cream background. In the bottom row, the left square shows a diagonal half-and-half design with red plaid (overlaid with white and black lines) on one side, and a white background with black dots forming lines on the other. The center bottom square is filled with a pattern of small blue floral shapes on a cream background. The right square in the bottom row features another diagonal half-and-half design, this time with a deep blue background marked with white diagonal lines on one half, and a white background with thin black horizontal lines on the other half. All squares are outlined by thin black lines, framing the composition against a cream background.
title: Quilt Patchwork
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
